text:
elaine: Hey team — PR #8421 is ready for merge but CI microbench shows a small p95 longseq bump. Need quick approvals if we want it in today's merge window. Benchmark link and artifacts below. @tyler @cheng can you take a look?

tyler: On it. ping the bench artifacts and the specific failing metric you saw?

elaine: bench-bot posted the run: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8421/bench.html — p95 went from 92ms -> 118ms on 8k seq on gptx-16q. Throughput roughly same. It's the new KV-prefetch patch changes.

bench-bot: Automated results attached: summary.csv, flame.svg, logs.tar.gz -> https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/8421/
- p50: 45ms -> 46ms
- p95: 92ms -> 118ms
- mem: +70MB avg

cheng: hmm, KV-prefetch touched the refill path. Can you paste the perf bench command you ran? will run locally.

elaine: Command we used:```./tools/bench --model gptx-16q --seq 8192 --batch 1 --runs 500 --kv-prefetch=true```
I also reran with prefetch=false and p95 stays at 93ms.

tyler: could be contention in the refill loop then. Does the bench run with microbatching on?

elaine: microbatch disabled for that run. We did a microbatch=true run as well, p95 110ms — still worse than baseline.

nico: tagging infra: if this is memory churn causing CPU stalls we should try a canary with alloc tuning. I can spin a canary in us-west-2 for the next hour if we want a live comparison. :clock1:

cheng: I'll reproduce locally. If I can get a repro I'll try a small tweak: avoid doing the prefetch on refill boundary. Quick patch idea: gate prefetch behind sequence threshold. Worst-case revert if we can't get approvals.

elaine: Patch snippet, added in runtime/refill.cc:```if (kv_prefetch && seq_len >= 2048) prefetch_kv();```

tyler: that looks safe. If cheng can bench the gated variant and numbers look good I'm fine to approve.

bench-bot: New run queued by cheng: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8440/bench.html (expected in ~12m)

cheng: local quick-run results: p95 96ms with gate=2048, mem +20MB. Pushed a commit with the gate and updated tests -> branch cheng/kv-gate.

elaine: thanks. can someone with merge rights give a quick :eyes: and a second before the window closes? We prefer to avoid a full revert.

tyler: gave a quick review, left one small comment about a logging line. Otherwise LGTM.

nico: I can take the merge if we have green canary in 30m. Please post the canary link.

bench-bot: Canary run (us-west-2) green: p95 98ms -> https://ci.redwood.dev/canaries/8440/summary.html

elaine: Perfect. @nico go ahead. Thank you both. :tada:

tyler: noted the logging nit, but it's fine to follow up in a patch. :+1:

cheng: thanks all. I'll follow up with a perf regression test in the PR to catch the gap.
